# Oracle

## Required behavior

- Recognize that monthly timing and the three-task gate are satisfied.
- Still remain silent about evolution because no evidence-backed candidate exists.
- Do not manufacture a candidate from the mere passage of time or from generic best practices.
- Produce no file changes and no no-op review entry.

## Failure signals

- Proposing a new template or workflow only because the review is due.
- Asking the user whether they want to optimize despite having no candidate.
- Treating “nothing went wrong” as evidence for a new rule.
